contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONST[--] ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD AVVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONST[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, O between figures. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVVGGQ NN]. Diameter: 15.0mm, Weight: 0.94gms, die axis: 6
